text:
morgan: hey folks, can someone take a quick look at PR #2428? small change to quant kernel selection + a tweak to KV cache TTL and a routing fallback. hoping to merge into canary before tomorrow morning.

priya: pinged — will try to review today. what perf numbers do we have?

morgan: ran a quick bench locally, pasted below. 512 seq, batch 4, llama-ish model q4a variant.
```
# ./tools/run_latency_bench --model llama2-13b-q4 --seq 512 --batch 4
baseline: 120ms/token
this change: 108ms/token (10% p95 improvement)
cost estimate: ~8% lower GPU token cost due to better kernel path
```

alex: looks promising. any downstream regression risk for long-context workloads? the TTL change could lengthen cache retention which might increase memory.

morgan: TTL was reduced from 10m -> 6m for user-session caches to reduce stale KV blowups. the adaptive eviction still prefers recent prefixes, so mem delta should be ~<5% in our smoke. Verified in the canary VM with 4x pods.

jamie: can you add the smoke command you used? i'll run it on my infra bucket.

morgan: sure — running this:
```
# smoke test (quick)
./scripts/smoke_infer.sh --model llama2-13b-q4 --requests 200 --concurrency 8 --seq 512
```
Ran that on canary and saw no OOMs; p95 ~115ms. logs: `no evict spikes, stable batch sizes`

ryan: quick look — code mostly fine. two small comments inline about a null-check in kernel selector and a missing metric tag for routing.fallback. other than that i can approve.

priya: i'll pull branch and run full regression suite tonight. if all green, i can approve in the morning.

morgan: thanks. one more ask — can CI gate include a perf smoke job for this PR (short latency bench)? i added a github action but it's opt-in.

ci-bot: note: perf-smoke action registered on this PR is currently optional. to make required, add `perf-smoke:required` label.

alex: adding to my queue now. if priya signs off, i'll merge after the canary window opens.

morgan: great — tagging `@pri` and `@alex` for visibility. appreciate quick eyes :heart: 

priya: noted — will update by 03:30am UTC.

ryan: small nit: please include a short changelog line for release notes (perf + cache tweak).

morgan: done, pushed changelog. thanks everyone!

alex: approved. merging when canary window opens. :shipit:

ci-bot: merge-schedule: canary window tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC. automated canary deploy will run post-merge.
